settings_scope_note: Applies to every worksite on this computer.
settings_density_description: Adjust text, spacing, and control sizes throughout the app.
settings_accessibility_description: Overrides for motion, contrast, text size and Assessment colors. Reduce motion follows your computer unless you choose otherwise.
settings_reduce_motion_description: Replaces zoom, pan and settle animations with plain changes. System follows your computer's setting.
settings_contrast_description: Darker borders and text throughout Wobble. This is an override, not a computer setting.
settings_colorblind_description: Swaps the Assessment colors for a palette that stays distinguishable with color-blindness.
settings_text_size_description: Multiplies Density: all text and rem-based spacing grow together.
settings_remember_window_description: Wobble reopens where you left it. If it opens off-screen, reset it.
settings_window_desktop_only: Window settings are available in the desktop app.
settings_region_sample: A note written now would read {timestamp}.
settings_data_description: Everything Wobble knows lives in one database file on this computer.
settings_backups_description: A backup is a complete copy of the database in one file. Wobble keeps working from the original.
settings_export_description: Write a copy of this installation's database to a file you choose.
settings_restore_description: Replace everything on this computer with the contents of a backup file.
settings_restore_needs_desktop: Restoring a backup needs the desktop app.
settings_backup_retention_description: Automatic backup deletion is not available.
settings_no_auto_backup: No automatic backup has run yet.
settings_update_current: You have the latest version. Checked just now.
settings_update_unavailable_description: Wobble cannot check for updates yet.
settings_update_auto_description: Wobble installs a downloaded update only when you quit, never while you work.
settings_update_channel_description: Preview builds arrive earlier and may be rougher.
settings_shortcuts_description: Shortcuts are fixed for now. They use Ctrl in place of ⌘ on Windows and Linux.
settings_shortcuts_commit: Commit an edited name or value
settings_shortcuts_remove_last: Remove the last Agitation or Language while the field is empty
settings_diagnostics_description: For when something goes wrong and you need to tell someone what happened.
settings_log_level_description: Log detail settings are not available.
settings_log_files_description: Log files and automatic log retention are not available.
settings_copy_diagnostics_description: Version, platform and database schema, as text to paste into a bug report.
settings_export_logs_description: Log export is not available. Copy info includes application details, without Worker data.
settings_lock_off: Wobble stays unlocked until it closes.
settings_lock_creating: Choose a password below to finish turning this on.
settings_lock_on: On. Wobble asks for the password before it shows anything.
settings_password_description: At least {count} characters. A few unrelated words is easier to remember than symbols.
settings_password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
settings_password_warning: Wobble cannot reset a forgotten password. Keep it somewhere safe, and keep a recent backup.
settings_reset_description: Resetting settings keeps your data. Erasing does not.
settings_reset_settings_description: Returns every saved setting to its default. Controls you have changed but not saved are left as they are. Workers, Notes and Worksites are not affected.
settings_erase_description: Removes every Worksite, Worker, Note and Relationship from the active database. A safety copy is kept.
settings_restore_dialog_description: Restoring replaces every Worksite on this computer with the contents of the backup file you choose. Before it does, Wobble saves a copy of the current data beside the database, adding a .pre-restore- timestamp before its file extension, so you can go back.
settings_restore_safety_copy: Restored. The data that was replaced is saved at:
settings_reset_dialog_description: Every saved setting returns to its default. Controls you have changed but not saved are left as they are. Your Worksites and workers are not changed.
settings_erase_dialog_title: Erase all data on this computer?
settings_erase_dialog_description: Wobble saves a safety copy beside the database before removing every Worksite, Worker, Note and Relationship. Settings are kept. Earlier backups and exports are not removed. Restore the safety copy to recover the erased data.
settings_erase_safety_copy: Erased from the active database. To recover the data, restore this safety copy:
settings_lock_off_dialog_description: Wobble will open without asking for a password. Enter your current password to confirm.
settings_data_error_read_path: Could not read the database path.
settings_data_error_read_details: Could not read the installation details.
settings_copy_failed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
settings_data_error_http_path: Could not read the database path (HTTP {status}).
settings_data_error_no_path: Wobble could not find this installation's database file.
settings_data_error_restore_path_require: Choose a backup file to restore.
settings_data_error_restore_unreadable: Wobble could not read that file. Check it still exists, then try again.
settings_data_error_restore_not_a_file: That is a folder, not a backup file. Choose a backup file instead.
settings_data_error_restore_current_file: That is the database Wobble is using now. Choose a different backup file.
settings_data_error_restore_not_sqlite: That file is not a Wobble backup. Choose a backup file Wobble made.
settings_data_error_restore_integrity: That backup is damaged and cannot be restored. Try another backup.
settings_data_error_restore_not_wobble: That file is a database, but not a Wobble one. Choose a backup file Wobble made.
settings_data_error_restore_unsupported_: That backup was made by a version of Wobble this app cannot open. Update Wobble, then try again.
settings_data_error_restore_failed: The backup could not be restored. Wobble saved a copy of the data from before the restore.
settings_data_error_erase_failed: The data could not be erased. Wobble saved a copy of the data from before the erase.
settings_restore_key_consequence: Restored data will use this installation’s current passphrase. The source file stays unchanged.
settings_restore_source_required: Enter the passphrase used when this backup was created, or choose legacy unencrypted restore.
settings_restore_error_key: This passphrase did not unlock the backup. Try again; if it is correct, the backup may be damaged.
settings_restore_error_legacy: Choose a supported unencrypted Wobble backup for legacy restore.
settings_recovery_required: Recovery must finish before more data can open. Keep the database and recovery files.
settings_encryption_on: The database and new exports and safety copies are encrypted. A passphrase is required each time Wobble starts.
settings_passphrase_error: The passphrase change could not finish. Keep the database and recovery files, then retry.
settings_passphrase_recovery: This recovery copy uses your previous passphrase. Earlier backups keep the passphrases they were created with.
